_comment: Scene-transition menus for 'Survival English — Advanced Beta' (docs/plans/SURVIVAL_ADVANCED_BETA_PLAN.md). Additive: nothing else reads this file, and the ordinary Survival mode never loads it. The beta system prompt injects the entries for the running scenario's category so the model proposes a move/time skip/new person/solo errand from THIS list instead of inventing an arbitrary one. 'errands' additionally carry fact_templates, which the app fills from fact_slots (no LLM) to build the relay card the learner has to report back.

moves.title: Step outside to keep talking?
moves.description: The two of you step outside where it is quieter, still mid-conversation.

moves.title: Find somewhere to sit?
moves.description: You both move to a place where you can sit down and keep the conversation going.

time_skips.title: Skip to later the same day?
time_skips.description: A few hours have passed. You run into each other again later the same day and pick the thread back up.

time_skips.title: Skip to next week?
time_skips.description: A week has gone by. You meet again and refer back to what was left unresolved last time.

new_characters.role: a second person who has just walked up
new_characters.title: Someone else joins in?
new_characters.description: A different person joins the scene and takes over the conversation with the user.

errands.title: Go and ask, then come back?
errands.description: The user goes off alone to ask, and comes back to report what they were told.
fact_templates: The person at the desk was {name}.
They said to come back at {time}.
There are {number} forms to fill in first.

moves.title: Walk to the information desk?
moves.description: You both walk over to the information desk in the main corridor and carry on talking there.

moves.title: Head down to the cafeteria?
moves.description: You walk down to the hospital cafeteria together and keep talking over a coffee.

time_skips.title: Skip to the end of the shift?
time_skips.description: The shift has ended. You run into each other on the way out and pick the conversation back up.

time_skips.title: Skip to next week?
time_skips.description: A week of the rotation has gone by and you meet again in the same corridor.

new_characters.role: front desk staff at the hospital information desk
new_characters.title: Talk to the front desk staff?
new_characters.description: The front desk staff member takes over and deals with the user directly.

new_characters.role: a ward clerk who handles paperwork and scheduling
new_characters.title: Ask the ward clerk instead?
new_characters.description: A ward clerk steps in and handles the request from here.

errands.title: Go ask at the desk and come back?
errands.description: The user goes alone to the information desk and returns to report what they were told.
fact_templates: You need to go to room {code} first.
The wait for the badge is {wait}.

errands.title: Check with the pharmacy and come back?
errands.description: The user walks to the pharmacy window alone and comes back to report the answer.
fact_templates: You have to bring {number} copies of the form.
Ask for {name} when you go back.

moves.title: Walk down to the platform?
moves.description: You both move down to the platform and keep talking while you wait.

moves.title: Go back to the ticket hall?
moves.description: You head back into the ticket hall together and continue from there.

time_skips.title: Skip past the delay?
time_skips.description: Forty minutes of delay have passed. You are still waiting together and pick the conversation back up.

time_skips.title: Skip to the trip back?
time_skips.description: Days later, you happen to be on the same route again and recognise each other.

new_characters.role: a ticket agent behind the counter
new_characters.title: Talk to the ticket agent?
new_characters.description: A ticket agent takes over and deals with the user's problem at the counter.

new_characters.title: Talk to another passenger?
new_characters.description: Another passenger who overheard turns to the user and starts a fresh conversation.

errands.title: Go check at the counter and come back?
errands.description: The user goes to the ticket counter alone and returns to report what they found out.
fact_templates: The agent said to ask for {name}.

moves.title: Move to the service counter?
moves.description: You move over to the service counter and continue the conversation there.

time_skips.title: Skip to when you come back?
time_skips.description: You came back a few hours later, as agreed, and the conversation resumes from there.

new_characters.role: the shop manager, called over to help
new_characters.title: Ask for the manager?
new_characters.description: The manager comes over and takes over the conversation with the user.

errands.place: the returns desk at the back
errands.title: Go to the returns desk and come back?
errands.description: The user goes to the returns desk alone and comes back to report what they were told.
fact_templates: They can only refund it until {day}.

moves.title: Move to a table?
moves.description: You take your things over to a table by the window and keep talking there.

time_skips.title: Skip to after the meal?
time_skips.description: The meal is finished and the plates are cleared. The conversation carries on over what is left of the drinks.

new_characters.role: the server looking after this table
new_characters.title: Talk to the server?
new_characters.description: The server comes over and deals with the user directly.

errands.title: Go order at the counter and come back?
errands.description: The user goes to the counter alone and returns to report what they were told.

moves.title: Walk to the department office?
moves.description: You both walk over to the department office and continue the conversation there.

time_skips.title: Skip to after the seminar?
time_skips.description: The seminar has finished. You catch each other on the way out and carry on.

new_characters.role: the department administrator who handles forms and rooms
new_characters.title: Ask the department admin?
new_characters.description: The department administrator takes over and handles the request.

errands.title: Go to the office and come back?
errands.description: The user goes to the department office alone and returns to report what they were told.

moves.title: Step into the hallway?
moves.description: You step out into the shared hallway and keep talking there.

time_skips.title: Skip a few days?
time_skips.description: A few days have passed and nothing has been fixed yet. You bring it up again.

new_characters.title: Talk to the building manager?
new_characters.description: The building manager takes over and deals with the user's problem.

errands.title: Go downstairs to ask and come back?
errands.description: The user goes down to the building office alone and returns to report what they were told.

moves.title: Move to the kitchen?
moves.description: You move into the kitchen where it is quieter and keep talking.

time_skips.title: Skip to later in the night?
time_skips.description: It is much later and the party has thinned out. You find each other again and carry on.

new_characters.title: Talk to the host?
new_characters.description: The host comes over and starts a fresh conversation with the user.

errands.place: the host in the other room
errands.title: Go ask the host and come back?
errands.description: The user goes to ask the host alone and comes back to report what they said.
fact_templates: The next place is on street {code}.

moves.place: out of the way, to one side
moves.title: Step out of the way?
moves.description: You move to one side, out of everyone's way, and sort it out there.

time_skips.title: Skip to once it settles down?
time_skips.description: The commotion has died down. You are still together afterwards and talk it through.

new_characters.role: whoever is in charge here, who has just arrived
new_characters.title: Talk to whoever's in charge?
new_characters.description: The person in charge arrives and takes over the conversation with the user.

errands.title: Go report it and come back?
errands.description: The user goes off alone to report it and comes back to say what happened.
fact_templates: They will get back to you by {day}.
The person who took the report was {name}.

moves.title: Go for a walk instead?
moves.description: You leave and walk somewhere else together, still talking.

time_skips.title: Skip to the next time you meet?
time_skips.description: Days have passed since then. You are meeting again and both remember how the last conversation ended.

new_characters.role: a close friend of the person the user was just talking to
new_characters.title: Their friend comes over?
new_characters.description: Their friend comes over and starts talking to the user while they are away.

errands.title: Go order and come back?
errands.description: The user goes to order alone and comes back to report how it went.
fact_templates: There is a {wait} wait on the food.

moves.title: Move on somewhere else?
moves.description: You get up and move on to somewhere else nearby, still deep in the same conversation.

time_skips.title: Skip a couple of hours?
time_skips.description: A couple of hours have gone by. You are both still there, and the conversation has kept going.

new_characters.role: a friend who has just turned up to join you
new_characters.title: A friend turns up?
new_characters.description: A friend arrives, and the user ends up talking with them instead.

errands.title: Go get refills and come back?
errands.description: The user goes to get refills alone and comes back to report what happened on the way.
fact_templates: The person behind the counter was {name}.
There were {number} people in the queue.
